entry.content:
Redump

The Redump project is a metadata database for CD-ROM preservation focused primarily in games.

The Hardware

Unlike disk image flux archiving, there’s no special enthusiast equipment needed here. Backing up CDs using these techniques uses standard off the shelf drives manufactured by Plextor

http://wiki.redump.org/index.php?title=Optical_Disc_Drive_Compatibility
